action.command:
date -u; echo "---"; echo '<html><body style="background:#123;color:#fff;font:40px sans-serif">TEST</body></html>' > /tmp/t.html && chromium --headless=new --no-sandbox --disable-gpu --hide-scrollbars --window-size=1280,720 --screenshot=/tmp/t.png --virtual-time-budget=2000 file:///tmp/t.html 2>&1 | tail -3; ls -l /tmp/t.png 2>/dev/null && python3 -c "
import struct
d=open('/tmp/t.png','rb').read()
w,h=struct.unpack('>II',d[16:24]); print('dimensi:',w,'x',h,'ukuran:',len(d),'byte')"
